summary.en: CyberLink supports PhotoDirector 2025, 2026 and 365 (15.7 or later) on Windows on Arm. Linaro lists PhotoDirector 365 as running under emulation.
summary.zh-TW: 訊連官方支援在 Windows on Arm 上執行相片大師 2025、2026 和 365（15.7 以上）。Linaro 目錄記錄相片大師 365 透過模擬執行。

caveats.en: WMV video export is not available. PhotoDirector 2024 is not recommended on Arm, because AI background removal does not work.
caveats.zh-TW: 無法匯出 WMV 影片。相片大師 2024 不建議在 Arm 上使用，因為 AI 去背無法運作。

evidence.title: CyberLink FAQ: What versions of CyberLink software support Windows 11 ARM platforms with Qualcomm CPU?
CyberLink PhotoDirector 2026 system requirements: Qualcomm Snapdragon X (Windows 11 ARM)
